content: The years teach much which the days never know.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
explanation: Daily events often seem chaotic, frustrating, or contradictory. Only the steady passage of years reveals the overarching wisdom and pattern of our journey.
practicalInsight: Do not judge the whole meaning of your life by the temporary setbacks of a difficult week.
reflectionPrompt: What past hardship now makes complete sense in the wider narrative of your life?
